items.name: Anthropic Claude Duet
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Duet, a proactive personal AI agent powered by Claude Opus 5.5, as a waitlisted research preview for US Pro and Max subscribers on iOS, Android, and claude.ai. It runs on its own cloud computer with 6,000+ Marketplace connectors, sends daily briefings, and keeps working while devices are off — Anthropic's direct answer to Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots.

items.name: iFlytek Spark X2.6
items.summary: iFlytek unveiled Spark X2.6 at its Global 1024 Developer Festival — a 293B-parameter MoE (A30B) model with 1M-token context, claimed as a breakthrough in code and agent capabilities trained entirely on domestic Chinese computing hardware. It also open-sourced the Spark X2.6-4B edge model.

items.name: Recursive Flint
items.summary: AI startup Recursive (CEO Richard Socher, ex-Salesforce chief scientist) released Flint, its first model: a free open-weight (Apache 2.0) coding MoE with 40B total / 2.5B active parameters that runs offline on laptops at ~131 tokens/sec on an M4 Pro. It was built from scratch in under four months with Recursive's automated research system handling nearly every step.

items.name: NVIDIA Kumo
items.summary: NVIDIA announced the Kumo family of open-weight foundation models that give AI agents a knowledge layer over structured enterprise data — specialized Tabular, Relational, Time Series, and Forecast models for predictions from databases. Available immediately on Hugging Face and as NVIDIA NIM microservices, with Coinbase among the early users.

items.name: Ai2 OlmoEarth v1.3
items.summary: The Allen Institute for AI released OlmoEarth v1.3, an open satellite-embedding model (ViT-Base) paired with precomputed annual embeddings for the entire planet at 10-meter resolution plus a no-sign-in browser-based Embeddings Explorer, making global land-cover mapping and change detection possible without a GPU.
